## Peer-Reviewed Research & Physical Robotics Artifacts
- **IEEE Xplore (Document ID: 10627276, Mar 2026)**: "Automated Edge Vision & Retail Checkout System using Quantized YOLOv5 on Embedded Hardware" - Lead Author. INT8 Post-Training Quantization via ONNX Runtime to balance activation dynamic ranges on ARM/Raspberry Pi hardware (<1% mAP degradation, sub-second 24.6ms inference).
- **HiWonder MentorPi M1 Autonomous Mobile Robot (ROS2)**: Raspberry Pi 5 under ROS2. Assembled chassis, flashed real-time system images, configured battery management, integrated monocular camera vision pipelines for autonomous SLAM navigation and obstacle avoidance.
- **Sensorless Solar Photovoltaic Tracking System**: Closed-loop tracking mechanism utilizing photovoltaic output voltage of solar panels to detect light intensity, eliminating fragile external sensors (LDRs) and reducing physical failure points.
